checks.description: Real HTTP, server-owned roles, persistence failure and restart; not browser interaction

expectedTests: test#starts on loopback; serves the browser; list starts empty
test#reader can save a trimmed title and author and read it back
test#reader cannot mark read through direct HTTP or forged role claims
test#server rejects blank, missing, wrong type, long, malformed and oversized input
test#cross-origin writes and unexpected Host are rejected
test#librarian marks read; repeating is idempotent; unknown book is 404
test#concurrent saves are serialized without losing recommendations
test#failed disk write returns an error and does not claim a saved change
test#saved list and read status survive an actual server process restart
